name: access-tab
js: tab = TABS.findIndex(t => t[1] === "access"); showTab(); state.access.allArrows = true;

name: clearing-all-arrows
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world = clone(DEFAULTS.world); worldEnter("3,3", null, false); const B = state.background; B.figX = 0; B.figY = 0; Object.assign(state.access, { allArrows: true });

name: clearing-all-arrows-big-pink
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world = clone(DEFAULTS.world); worldEnter("3,3", null, false); const B = state.background; B.figX = 0; B.figY = 0; Object.assign(state.access, { allArrows: true, arrowSize: 180, arrowColor: "#f472b6", arrowDim: 60 });

name: clearing-words-180
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world = clone(DEFAULTS.world); worldEnter("3,3", null, false); const B = state.background; B.figX = 0; B.figY = 0; Object.assign(state.access, { gameFont: 180 });

name: livingroom-path
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world.at = null; const B = state.background; Object.assign(B, { kind: "livingroom", figX: -300, figY: 60 }); state.access.showPath = true; changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); measureMarks(); const p = marks.pics.find(q => q.kind === "door" || q.kind === "doorway" || q.kind === "sign"); if (p) enterScene(p.el);

name: livingroom-collision-boxes
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world.at = null; Object.assign(state.background, { kind: "livingroom", figX: 0, figY: 40 }); state.access.showSolids = true;

name: castleroom-collision-boxes
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world.at = null; Object.assign(state.background, { kind: "castleroom", castle: "N", castleRoom: 1, figX: 0, figY: 40 }); state.access.showSolids = true;
